title: Luxuriant Rich Northern Irish Potatoes Bubble And Squeak
description: A rich, comforting British dish featuring potatoes, cocoa powder, and a sweet glaze, made FODMAP-friendly for all to enjoy.

ingredients.name: glaze
ingredients.notes: made from reduced sugar and water

instructions: Boil the diced potatoes in salted water until they are tender, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, saute the diced onion and carrots in butter until they are softened.
Add the cooked potatoes, cocoa powder, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Using a spatula, shape the mixture into a round shape and press down gently to form a flat top.
Brush the top of the bubble and squeak with the sweet glaze.
Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes on the first side, then flip and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
